events.title: Lua 5.1 released
events.summary: The Lua team released Lua 5.1 on February 21, 2006 with a new garbage collector, module system (`require`), and vararg improvements.
events.about: Lua 5.1 is the dialect embedded in Redis scripting, World of Warcraft addons, and millions of game engines — the version most hosts still target. Modules and the GC rewrite made long-running embedded scripts more reliable.

narrative.whyChosen: Lua 5.1 became the de facto embedded Lua for a decade of games and infrastructure.
narrative.whyImportant: The module system standardized how C hosts load Lua libraries.
narrative.problemSolved: Lua 5.0's package model was awkward for large embedded codebases.
